parts:
How can I upload ".str" and ".gen" file in Shiny?

This command is wrong:

ui

fileInput('file', 'Choose File', accept=c('.gen','.str','.csv','txt'))

server

File<-input$file
read.structure(File$datapath) or read.genepop(File$datapath)

Thanks
